name: Warmth
text: A warmth spreads from your chest to your fingertips, as if someone had laid a cloak on your shoulders.
effect: Once before your next long rest, add 1d4 to one saving throw.

name: Steady hand
text: The candle flame stops flickering the moment you look at it.
effect: Once before your next long rest, add 1d4 to one attack roll.

name: A name in the smoke
text: The incense smoke curls into a shape you almost recognise, then is gone.

name: Quiet mind
text: For a moment the noise of the world falls away, and you hear only your own breath.
effect: Advantage on your next Wisdom (Insight) check today.

name: Guiding light
text: A shaft of light falls across the floor and points, briefly, towards the door.

name: Second wind
text: You stand up lighter than you knelt down.
effect: Regain 1d6 hit points the next time you finish a short rest.

name: Silence
text: Nothing happens. The silence feels deliberate and gives you peace.

name: A cold touch
text: The stone under your knees is cold, colder than it should be, and you feel watched.
effect: Disadvantage on your next Charisma check today. The gods are displeased, or busy.

name: Courage
text: A voice you know, though not from where, tells you: not yet.
effect: Advantage on your next saving throw against being frightened.

name: Good fortune
text: A coin you did not drop lies at the foot of the altar.
effect: You find 1d6 sp on your way out.

name: The road ahead
text: You dream that night of a road, a crossroads, and a lantern left burning.
effect: You gain a small hint about your current quest.

name: Peace
text: Old aches you had forgotten about are, for once, gone.

name: Gift of the Verb
text: The inner light of Oghma fills you, giving you confidence and focus.
effect: You gain a +2 to charisma for social encounters that requires you to convince someone for 24 hours.
